import datetime as dt
from humanize import naturaldelta, naturaltime

# Test with very large timedelta (this works)
huge = dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
print('naturaldelta huge timedelta:', repr(naturaldelta(huge)))
print('naturaltime huge timedelta:', repr(naturaltime(huge)))

# What about a reasonable large value?
large = dt.timedelta(days=10000)
print('naturaldelta 10000 days:', repr(naturaldelta(large)))
print('naturaltime 10000 days:', repr(naturaltime(large)))
"
